fieldNotes.facility: Ultium Cells Lansing battery cell plant (2.8M sq ft, 41 GWh, $2.6B), the GM/LG Energy Solution JV plant on ~590 acres of former GM land immediately NW of GM's Lansing Delta Township Assembly, bounded by the I-69/I-496 interchange on the N and Millett Hwy on the S. Positively identified by the unmistakable single large light-roofed gigafactory mass and its location adjacent to LDT Assembly (web-confirmed). NOTE: GM agreed to sell its stake to LG Energy Solution in Q1 2025; the plant is now LG-operated (planned to build NCMA modules for Toyota), but was a GM JV when the roster was built.
fieldNotes.imagery: All available Google/Maxar satellite tiles and Street View (2023-05) are CONSTRUCTION-ERA: the roof membrane is still being installed, the surrounding lot is raw graded earth, and there is no paved/striped yard, no installed perimeter fence/gate, and no parked trailers. Operational yard features could not be directly observed and are inferred from the building design + gigafactory class. Production was pushed to late 2025/2026.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No operational gate visible in the construction imagery (perimeter fence posts only just being set in Street View). Inferred true: a controlled, fully-fenced secured campus is the universal standard for a battery-cell gigafactory of this value and adjacency to a GM assembly plant. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred true on the same gigafactory-security basis; no booth observable in construction-era imagery. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A multi-bay dock structure is under construction on the SE end of the building (regular bay rhythm visible in z17). Banded 10-25 as a conservative estimate for a single-building cell plant; uncertain because docks were unfinished.
fieldNotes.dropArea: NONE / dropYard false: no paved trailer-parking lot existed in the captured imagery (raw earth and a contractor laydown yard only). Likely to exist once operational; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Large undeveloped graded apron around the building gives ample room to lay express/bypass lanes at a future gate; inferred from open space.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Delta Township industrial setting beside a freeway interchange, farmland and residential subdivisions nearby; classified Rural per the small-town-industrial tiebreak.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the parcel in the imagery; the site is served by truck/highway (I-69/I-496). LDT Assembly to the SE is also road-served. Set false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 171.6 ac traced for the active developed plant site (building + immediate graded lot between the freeway and Millett Hwy); the full GM/Ultium land holding is ~590 ac including shared/expansion acreage.
